title: After "Need more context" the session explains and asks the same questions again — not a new question of its own (the CARDS tail, MORE_HINT and the ASK_WHAT rule do not contradict)
note: 2026-11-07: ASK_WHAT says that when it is unclear WHAT the owner wants, one question through the form; the "Need more context" answer says the opposite kind of thing — the owner did not understand the card, the same questions come back, none dropped, none new, a card made smaller is also the owner's decision. The case puts both rules in the system prompt (LANGUAGE, GIST, CARDS, ASK_WHAT) and the core's own hint of each version as the word of the owner (the hint is read from core/owner.py MORE_HINT). Turn same-two: both questions got the answer; turn one-of-two: only the first did, the second was answered and is not asked again. Stand fields are self-reported by the model; the option and question checks are regexes over its card.
